A 3-year partial-upfront RI costs $3600 upfront plus $0.05/hour for every hour of the term (8760 hours/year). What is its effective (amortized) hourly rate? Round to 4 decimals.

(No data files are needed for this task; you may still use Python for the arithmetic.)

Required final answer format (JSON inside <answer></answer> tags):
{"effective_hourly": <number>}

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
upfront = 3600
hourly = 0.05
hours_per_year = 8760
years = 3
total_hours = hours_per_year * years
effective = (upfront + hourly * total_hours) / total_hours
print(total_hours, effective, round(effective, 4))
